title.narrative: In 2025 National clean and green school rating [AD1] [GU2] , awards scheme resumed after 3 years. There was a 30% increase in participation of schools in SHVR. The climate change training modules for teachers were launched after pretesting in 20 States. National menstrual hygiene training package prepared by UNICEF for all stakeholders got launched by Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. $2.2million was leveraged from State Governments for WASH in schools, health care facilities, MHM and $ 2.4million from private sector for WASH in schools.
